00001| 'use client';
00002| 
00003| // Inspired by react-hot-toast library
00004| import * as React from 'react';
00005| 
00006| import type { ToastActionElement, ToastProps } from '@/components/ui/toast';
00007| 
00008| const TOAST_LIMIT = 1;
00009| const TOAST_REMOVE_DELAY = 1000000;
00010| 
00011| type ToasterToast = ToastProps & {
00012|   id: string;
00013|   title?: React.ReactNode;
00014|   description?: React.ReactNode;
00015|   action?: ToastActionElement;
00016| };
00017| 
00018| const actionTypes = {
00019|   ADD_TOAST: 'ADD_TOAST',
00020|   UPDATE_TOAST: 'UPDATE_TOAST',
00021|   DISMISS_TOAST: 'DISMISS_TOAST',
00022|   REMOVE_TOAST: 'REMOVE_TOAST',
00023| } as const;
00024| 
00025| let count = 0;
00026| 
00027| function genId() {
00028|   count = (count + 1) % Number.MAX_SAFE_INTEGER;
00029|   return count.toString();
00030| }
00031| 
00032| type ActionType = typeof actionTypes;
00033| 
00034| type Action =
00035|   | {
00036|       type: ActionType['ADD_TOAST'];
00037|       toast: ToasterToast;
00038|     }
00039|   | {
00040|       type: ActionType['UPDATE_TOAST'];
00041|       toast: Partial<ToasterToast>;
00042|     }
00043|   | {
00044|       type: ActionType['DISMISS_TOAST'];
00045|       toastId?: ToasterToast['id'];
00046|     }
00047|   | {
00048|       type: ActionType['REMOVE_TOAST'];
00049|       toastId?: ToasterToast['id'];
00050|     };
00051| 
00052| interface State {
00053|   toasts: ToasterToast[];
00054| }
00055| 
00056| const toastTimeouts = new Map<string, ReturnType<typeof setTimeout>>();
00057| 
00058| const addToRemoveQueue = (toastId: string) => {
00059|   if (toastTimeouts.has(toastId)) {
00060|     return;
00061|   }
00062| 
00063|   const timeout = setTimeout(() => {
00064|     toastTimeouts.delete(toastId);
00065|     dispatch({
00066|       type: 'REMOVE_TOAST',
00067|       toastId: toastId,
00068|     });
00069|   }, TOAST_REMOVE_DELAY);
00070| 
00071|   toastTimeouts.set(toastId, timeout);
00072| };
00073| 
00074| export const reducer = (state: State, action: Action): State => {
00075|   switch (action.type) {
00076|     case 'ADD_TOAST':
00077|       return {
00078|         ...state,
00079|         toasts: [action.toast, ...state.toasts].slice(0, TOAST_LIMIT),
00080|       };
00081| 
00082|     case 'UPDATE_TOAST':
00083|       return {
00084|         ...state,
00085|         toasts: state.toasts.map((t) =>
00086|           t.id === action.toast.id ? { ...t, ...action.toast } : t
00087|         ),
00088|       };
00089| 
00090|     case 'DISMISS_TOAST': {
00091|       const { toastId } = action;
00092| 
00093|       // ! Side effects ! - This could be extracted into a dismissToast() action,
00094|       // but I'll keep it here for simplicity
00095|       if (toastId) {
00096|         addToRemoveQueue(toastId);
00097|       } else {
00098|         state.toasts.forEach((toast) => {
00099|           addToRemoveQueue(toast.id);
00100|         });
00101|       }
00102| 
00103|       return {
00104|         ...state,
00105|         toasts: state.toasts.map((t) =>
00106|           t.id === toastId || toastId === undefined
00107|             ? {
00108|                 ...t,
00109|                 open: false,
00110|               }
00111|             : t
00112|         ),
00113|       };
00114|     }
00115|     case 'REMOVE_TOAST':
00116|       if (action.toastId === undefined) {
00117|         return {
00118|           ...state,
00119|           toasts: [],
00120|         };
00121|       }
00122|       return {
00123|         ...state,
00124|         toasts: state.toasts.filter((t) => t.id !== action.toastId),
00125|       };
00126|   }
00127| };
00128| 
00129| const listeners: Array<(state: State) => void> = [];
00130| 
00131| let memoryState: State = { toasts: [] };
00132| 
00133| function dispatch(action: Action) {
00134|   memoryState = reducer(memoryState, action);
00135|   listeners.forEach((listener) => {
00136|     listener(memoryState);
00137|   });
00138| }
00139| 
00140| type Toast = Omit<ToasterToast, 'id'>;
00141| 
00142| function toast({ ...props }: Toast) {
00143|   const id = genId();
00144| 
00145|   const update = (props: ToasterToast) =>
00146|     dispatch({
00147|       type: 'UPDATE_TOAST',
00148|       toast: { ...props, id },
00149|     });
00150|   const dismiss = () => dispatch({ type: 'DISMISS_TOAST', toastId: id });
00151| 
00152|   dispatch({
00153|     type: 'ADD_TOAST',
00154|     toast: {
00155|       ...props,
00156|       id,
00157|       open: true,
00158|       onOpenChange: (open) => {
00159|         if (!open) dismiss();
00160|       },
00161|     },
00162|   });
00163| 
00164|   return {
00165|     id: id,
00166|     dismiss,
00167|     update,
00168|   };
00169| }
00170| 
00171| function useToast() {
00172|   const [state, setState] = React.useState<State>(memoryState);
00173| 
00174|   React.useEffect(() => {
00175|     listeners.push(setState);
00176|     return () => {
00177|       const index = listeners.indexOf(setState);
00178|       if (index > -1) {
00179|         listeners.splice(index, 1);
00180|       }
00181|     };
00182|   }, [state]);
00183| 
00184|   return {
00185|     ...state,
00186|     toast,
00187|     dismiss: (toastId?: string) => dispatch({ type: 'DISMISS_TOAST', toastId }),
00188|   };
00189| }
00190| 
00191| export { useToast, toast };
00192| 
</file>
